sentences.en: The treaty has been concluded after many twists and turns.
sentences.zh: 经过许多曲折之后，条约终于达成。

sentences.en: Local officials are twisting arms to push new development projects.
sentences.zh: 当地官员想方设法推动新的发展项目。

sentences.en: Twist that knob to the right and the box will open.
sentences.zh: 向右拧这个旋钮，箱子就会打开。
